description: This file defines the PersistableManufacturer class, which extends ManufacturerEntity and implements Serializable. It manages a list of ManufacturerDescription objects and provides getter and setter methods for them.

classes.name: PersistableManufacturer
classes.description: A serializable entity class representing a manufacturer with descriptions.

methods.name: setDescriptions
methods.description: Sets the list of ManufacturerDescription objects.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves the list of ManufacturerDescription objects.
